fusions.name: Held Draw
fusions.desc: Holds still at full draw for 1.2 seconds, then looses your tongue at the first enemy within 9 tiles for 34 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Regrown Quiver
fusions.desc: Looses 3 tail spines at once, spread apart out to 7 tiles, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Tongue at Full Stretch
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

fusions.name: Strung Tight
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 15 seconds.
